name: Galina Express Logistics Integration
author: galinaexpress

sections.description:
Galina Express Delivery for WooCommerce

Galina Express Delivery is a WooCommerce logistics integration designed for online stores operating in Iraq. The plugin allows merchants to connect their WooCommerce dashboard directly with Galina Express last-mile delivery services, making shipment creation, tracking, COD handling, and delivery management easier from one place.

About Galina Express

Galina Express is a tech-enabled logistics and fulfillment company in Iraq, providing last-mile delivery, warehousing, fulfillment, cash-on-delivery collection, and cross-border logistics solutions for e-commerce businesses, marketplaces, and 3PL partners.

Key Features

  • Direct integration between WooCommerce and Galina Express logistics services.
  • Automatic shipment creation from WooCommerce orders.
  • Manual shipment creation option from the WooCommerce order page.
  • Shipment tracking and delivery status synchronization.
  • Cash on Delivery support.
  • Support for Delivery, Pickup, and Pickup & Delivery service types.
  • Shipping method available in WooCommerce Shipping Zones as “Galina Express”.
  • Auto-created shipments are limited to Iraq destination orders.
  • Secure API credential configuration through the WordPress admin dashboard.
  • Customer delivery information, order details, and shipment data are sent only when shipment features are used.
  • Optional delivery coordinate selection through map, browser geolocation, or manual entry.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or higher.
  • WooCommerce installed and active.
  • Active Galina Express commercial account.
  • Valid Galina Express API credentials.

Support

To start using Galina Express Delivery for WooCommerce, merchants need to contact Galina Express for account activation, API credentials, contract terms, and delivery rates inside Iraq.

For technical support, commercial agreements, delivery pricing, and onboarding, please contact:

Email: customerservice@galinaexpress.com
Phone: +964 775 448 4400
Website: galinaexpress.com

Our team will support you with technical setup, integration guidance, delivery rate confirmation, and service activation for your WooCommerce store.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the Galina Express Delivery plugin from your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active. This plugin requires WooCommerce. (WordPress.org)
  3. Open the Galina Express plugin settings.
  4. Configure your Galina Express API credentials, including:
    • API Base URL
    • API Key
    • Tenant ID
    • Supplier ID
  5. Save the settings and test the API connection.
  6. Add “Galina Express” as a shipping method in your WooCommerce Shipping Zones.
  7. Start creating shipments from WooCommerce orders manually or automatically, depending on your configuration.
  8. Track shipment status directly from the WooCommerce order page.
